EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you know of any large furniture
I could plop down into a big, empty
space, let me know, will ya?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si sabes de algún mueble grande
que me sirva para rellenar un hueco
que tengo en casa, avísame, ¿eh?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu repères un gros meuble,
tiens-moi au courant, tu veux ? J'ai
de l'espace en rab...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se ti capita di vedere un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mobile {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}che
potrei usare per riempire un grosso
spazio vuoto, me lo fai sapere?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn du beim Schaufensterjoggen
oder so über ein großes Möbelstück
stolperst, sagst du's mir, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}okay?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kocaman boşluğa pat diye koyabileceğim
iri bir mobilya biliyorsan haber
ver, tamam mı?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you can get me some furniture
good for fitting snugly into small
areas, let me know!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si puedes ayudarme a encontrar
algún mueble que se pueda encajar
en un huequecillo de casa, ¡avísame!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu croises un meuble de
taille moyenne sympa, fais-le-moi
savoir, steup !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Fammi sapere se riesci a procurarti
un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mobile {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}abbastanza piccolo
da entrare in uno spazio stretto!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dar yerlere sıkı sıkıya oturacak
bir mobilya bulursan haber ver!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you've got the inside scoop on
furniture that's on the smallish side,
tell me about it!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si le echas el ojo a algún mueble
tirando a pequeño, ¡avísame!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu tombes sur un meuble
stylé de petite taille, merci de m'en
tenir informé !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Küçük sayılabilecek mobilyalarla ilgili
sağlam bir tüyo bulursan bana söyle!

EN:
Let me know if you have any ideas
about stuff I can use to replace my
old {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}As long as it's the same size, we
should be golden.
ES:
Tú dime si tienes ideas sobre qué
mueble puedo usar para sustituir
mi {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Con tal de que tenga el mismo
tamaño, a mí me da igual
lo que sea, la verdad.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu as une idée de meuble
pour remplacer mon {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0C0061006E006300690065006E00100061006E006300690065006E006E0065000000}}
{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}...
Je prendrai n'importe quoi qui fasse
la même taille !
TRANSLATION:
Eski {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} yerine kullanabileceğim
bir şey fikrin varsa haber ver.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Aynı
boyutta olsun yeter, gerisi kolay.

EN:
I want something for my lift-and-set
workout—something I can put on
top of my {{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}!
ES:
¡Quiero algo que pueda poner
sobre mi {{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}!
FR:
Je cherche une babiole à poser sur
{{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} que
j'ai chez moi. Une idée ?
TRANSLATION:
Kaldır-bırak antrenmanım için bir şey
istiyorum—{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} üstüne
koyabileceğim bir şey!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tell me if you have any ideas about
how I can update my ancient
{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'aimerais vraiment remplacer
{{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} que
j'ai chez moi. Un conseil ?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Antika olmuş {{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} eşyamı nasıl
yenileyebileceğime dair fikrin
varsa söyle.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you know of any objects I can
hang on my walls, please give me a
heads-up! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si sabes de algún objeto que pueda
colgar de las paredes, ¡ya sabes
dónde estoy, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu penses à un chouette
objet que je pourrais fixer au mur,
tiens-moi au jus,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Che cosa potrei appendere sul muro
di casa? Se ti viene in mente
qualcosa... {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hätte echt gern was Schönes für
meine Wände. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wenn dir was einfällt,
wär ich dir dankbar, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Duvarlarıma asabileceğim bir şey
biliyorsan bana haber çak! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
Let me know if you have a line on
any furniture I could use to replace
my old {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}!
ES:
¡Avísame si estás al tanto de algún
mueble que vaya bien para sustituir
mi viej{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD02006F000200610002003000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}!
IT:
Fammi sapere se ti viene qualche
idea su un mobile con cui sostituire
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}}!
TRANSLATION:
Eski {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0011:0003:0000}} yerine koyabileceğim
bir mobilya bulursan haber ver!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you come across any furniture
you think would suit my place, don't
hesitate to send it my way!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si te encuentras algún mueble
que pueda ir bien en mi casa,
¡no dudes en pasármelo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si jamais tu trouves un meuble qui
selon toi aurait sa place chez moi,
n'hésite pas à m'en parler !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se trovi un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mobile {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}che potrebbe
andare bene per casa mia,
mandamelo pure!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn du über irgendein Möbelstück
stolperst, das in meine Bude passt,
musst du's mir bringen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evime yakışacağını düşündüğün
bir mobilyaya rastlarsan hiç
çekinmeden bana yolla!
